compartments.label: gamma4
compartments.biology: PAM-gamma4 sugar-reward dopamine neurons depress KC inputs to MBON-gamma4>gamma1gamma2 (Aso 2014; Yamagata 2015; Cohn 2015).

compartments.label: gamma5
compartments.biology: PAM-gamma5 sugar-reward dopamine neurons depress KC inputs to MBON-gamma5beta'2a (Aso 2014; Yamagata 2015).

odor_code.rate_anchor: Zhao et al. 2022 Figure 7: ab1B/Or92a change of 118 spikes/s to 2,3-butanedione 1e-3 v/v; transferred uniformly to every cell of each selected ORN type

reinforcer.cells: every PAM08 and PAM01 dopamine neuron
reinforcer.status: engineered optogenetic-style substitute; the sweet GRN pathway does not reach any dopamine neuron at 0.11 mV/contact (measured)

interventions_justification.alln_output_gain: Measured: with local-neuron output intact, 4 ORN types at 118 Hz drove 18,400-24,000 spikes per 100 ms in the antennal lobe that persisted after odor offset; with it zeroed the lobe recovered fully within 100 ms.
interventions_justification.apl_output_gain: Measured: the spiking APL proxy delivered 21,582 contact-weighted inhibitory events onto MBON01 and 31,192 onto MBON05 during one odor trial and silenced both; with 0.25 they stayed silent; with 0 MBON05 fired 80 spikes and KC activity stayed at 5%.
interventions_justification.dopamine_fast_output_gain: Dopamine is modelled as a modulator acting only through the plasticity rule; the ambiguous +1 fast sign otherwise excites MBON01/MBON05 directly during reinforcement (51/54 spikes measured).
